'''NS-36 Enforcer Droid''' was a model of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] in service of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Some units could be found defending Imperial territory on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].
